entities.name: Abū Lahab
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: ʿAbd al-ʿUzzā ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib , better known as Abū Lahab was the Islamic prophet Muhammad's half paternal uncle. He was one of the Meccan Quraysh leaders who opposed the Prophet and was condemned in Surat Al-Masad of the Quran.
